assign.outcome:
**The site has one search box, at the bottom of every page.** Press `/` (or Ctrl/Cmd K) anywhere; type three letters; the box grows upward into a wall of cards. Arrow keys walk them, Enter opens one, Escape closes. The ⇧ button moves the box to the top and remembers it.

![](shot.png)

**What landed**

- [`core/Search`](/framework/core/Search/) — the corpus and the ranking, no DOM at all (the data tier, like `Item`/`List`), plus `Search.Filters`, plus `Omnibox.js`, the one box. Mounted by a single call in `app.js`.
- [How the corpus is counted](/framework/core/Search/doc/corpus/) · [what graduated from the prototype](/framework/core/Search/doc/decisions/) · [the facet model](/framework/core/Search/doc/filters/)
- [`ext/Omnibox`](/framework/ext/Omnibox/) is now a **pointer**: 30 lines that say where the box went and open it. Its stylesheet is deleted — it was hiding the new wall.

**The corpus is the Router's own walk.** Every row was produced by `Page.load()`, the exact call that runs when you navigate, so a result can never promise a page the Router then fails to open. **568 pages, from 570 urls tried, in 872 ms** — read the first time somebody searches, never on a page load. The two numbers agree by construction: `rows` is the subset of `candidates` that came back a real `Page`.

**Proved** at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440: **1 / 4 / 6 / 6 columns**, 40 cards then a *show more*, zero horizontal scroll, nothing at x:0. A chip narrowed 64 matches to 42, all in one section. Moved to the top, reloaded, still at the top. **Zero console errors on `/`, `/framework/`, `/imagine/` and `/blog/` at all four widths**, exactly one box on each.

**The finding worth reading:** *importing a page module changes the document you are standing on.* `View.stylesheet()` runs at module scope, so reading the corpus pulled ~70 page stylesheets into `<head>` — and four personal sandboxes repainted the whole site. `/castin/main.css` opens an undeclared `@layer theme_cm`, which sorts after all four declared layers and beat every framework rule; `/alex/` and `/edric/` ship unlayered CSS; `/arya/lib/Page.js` runs `app.$body.ac("arya")` at module scope and re-themed the page with one class. All four are skipped by url with the citation beside them, and `Search.check()` now warns by name if a fifth appears. Verified clean: every computed style is identical before and after a build.

**Left for someone whose fence covers it**

- `/framework/styles/layouts/flex/` and `/grid/` throw `this.words is not a function` — a `words:` data key shadowing a method. Both 404 for a reader today.
- The four sandbox stylesheets above; fixing them deletes four lines of `Search.prototype.skip`.
- [`/imagine/platform/omnibox/`](/imagine/platform/omnibox/) still describes the retired prototype and its stats line reads "indexing…" forever.
- `core/page.js`'s own sentence still says *four are an element, three are not* — with `Search` and `Layout` it is five and four.
